svg.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif
svg.title: Language runtime architecture
svg.text: the proof travels with the code
asserts the stack map at every pc
Young / Old is a per-object tag
a rejected module is a compiler bug; the VM never runs unverified bytecode
no allocation-failure trigger: the heap grows; collections come from the stress scheduler, the Collect opcode or the embedder
